tours.name: Investigate a Payslip with a Warning or Wrong Amount

name_i18n.en_US: Investigate a Payslip with a Warning or Wrong Amount

tours.description: Learn how to investigate a payslip that shows a warning or an unexpected amount: open the payslip, check the worked days it is based on, and open the employee's work entries to find and correct the cause before recomputing.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to investigate a payslip that shows a warning or an unexpected amount: open the payslip, check the worked days it is based on, and open the employee's work entries to find and correct the cause before recomputing.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Payslips that show a warning or an unexpected amount are investigated from the Payslips list in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips that show a warning or an unexpected amount are investigated from the Payslips list in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and the batches they belong to.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and the batches they belong to.

steps.title: All Payslips
steps.description: This list shows every payslip. Payslips with a problem are flagged with a warning or have an amount that looks wrong, such as a negative net salary.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every payslip. Payslips with a problem are flagged with a warning or have an amount that looks wrong, such as a negative net salary.

steps.title: Open a batch
steps.content: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

steps.description: Payslips are grouped by batch. Expand the batch that contains the payslip you want to check.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips are grouped by batch. Expand the batch that contains the payslip you want to check.

steps.title: Open the payslip
steps.content: Click the payslip to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the payslip to open it.

steps.description: If the payslip has a problem, a warning message is shown at the top of the form and explains what is wrong, for example work entries in conflict or a missing contract.

description_i18n.en_US: If the payslip has a problem, a warning message is shown at the top of the form and explains what is wrong, for example work entries in conflict or a missing contract.

steps.title: Worked days and inputs
steps.content: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

steps.description: Most payslip problems come from the days the pay is based on. Compare the number of days and hours with what you expect for the period.

description_i18n.en_US: Most payslip problems come from the days the pay is based on. Compare the number of days and hours with what you expect for the period.

steps.title: Work Entries
steps.content: Click Work Entries to see the employee's attendance and leave records.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Work Entries to see the employee's attendance and leave records.

steps.description: Work entries are the daily records of presence, leave and absence that feed the payslip. A conflict or a missing entry here is the usual cause of a warning.

description_i18n.en_US: Work entries are the daily records of presence, leave and absence that feed the payslip. A conflict or a missing entry here is the usual cause of a warning.

steps.title: Correct and recompute
steps.content: Review the entries, then click the search bar to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Review the entries, then click the search bar to finish.

steps.description: Fix any conflicting or missing entry in this list. Then go back to the payslip with the breadcrumb and click Compute Sheet to recalculate it with the corrected data.

description_i18n.en_US: Fix any conflicting or missing entry in this list. Then go back to the payslip with the breadcrumb and click Compute Sheet to recalculate it with the corrected data.
